name: UHGEval
description: A benchmark for evaluating hallucination in Chinese large language models via unconstrained text generation. It contains hallucinations generated by LLMs with minimal restrictions and provides a comprehensive evaluation framework for scalable and reproducible experiments.
reputation: A relatively new Chinese hallucination benchmark from the literature that is cited as a useful evaluation framework, but it is not yet a widely standardized community leaderboard.
notes: Focuses on unconstrained hallucination generation rather than constrained or induced hallucinations; fills a gap for Chinese-language hallucination evaluation.
